Lexical prefix binding graphs, interleaved value/function definitions, self/mutual recursion, and forward declarations after return. Elm parameter shadowing remains rejected; later closure combinations retain their gates.
Direct global references and bound receiver partial application, including zero parameters.
User-approved Decimal.fromFloat constructor mapping, including negative, scaled, and maximum decimal literals.
Written floating value without CLR Single quantization.
Nested owner paths, private types/methods, escaped names, complete namespace-segment selection.
Written width casts, Int/Float/Decimal conversions and Char code conversion; no implicit cross-carrier conversion.
Basics.remainderBy with divisor then dividend, as in the paired Elm input.
Listed numeric SDK methods, string conversion, String.length, Math.PI and Math.E.
Scalar constructors; add/sub/mul/negate/abs/round/truncate, comparisons, equality, string conversion, Zero/One/MinusOne.
Record equality/inequality and record updates; field dictionary order matches Elm.
Value-tuple equality uses the same Basics.equal as the paired Elm expression.
Void declarations map to Unit. Zero-parameter Action references map directly to Unit-valued definitions; no adapter.
Approved single-argument filter/map, seeded fold adapter, and ToList/ToArray on List carriers; unlisted overloads rejected.
